explanation: Matches the closing question of Bugeaud-Moshchevitin (arXiv:1009.4528, IRMA copy), reproduced in the docstring: are there arbitrarily large α not Pisot with all {αⁿ}, n≥1, in an interval of length ε/α? Lean: for each ε>0 and each M there is α>M non-Pisot with fractional parts in [c,c+ε/α] for some c. IsPisot is the standard definition. I checked the wording through the search result of that copy, and did not check for later progress.
